title: Tickets
headline: 1 ticket = 1 USDC = 1 ranked attempt. Up to 3 attempts per wallet per UTC day. Your best one counts.
sales_closed: Ticket sales open once the prize program is live on Solana mainnet. Adventure mode is free while you wait.
split_info: The split happens on-chain, inside the purchase transaction. No referrer? That 5% goes to the team, so the team gets 30%.
pkg_champion_note: The most you can buy at once
err_closed: Ticket sales open once the prize program is live on mainnet.
err_sign: This wallet can't sign messages. Try Phantom or Solflare.
err_funds: Not enough USDC. You have {have}, this pack needs {need}.
err_no_account: This wallet has no USDC account yet.
err_not_credited: Paid (tx {sig}…) but not credited yet: {msg}. Reopen this page to retry.
info_credits_desc: Our server checks the transaction on-chain, then adds the tickets to your wallet. Keep the transaction link as your receipt.
legal: 18+ only. Paid skill contests follow different rules in different countries, so check yours. Only spend what you can afford to lose.
